summary: This Form 8-K reports Interactive Strength, Inc.'s entry into a material definitive agreement following an accredited investor's exercise of Class B incremental warrants to purchase a $2,000,000 principal amount senior secured convertible note (the July 2026 Class B Incremental Note) and associated common stock purchase warrants for 305,810 shares of common stock, based on a July 20, 2026 closing price of $3.27. The note matures on July 21, 2027, is convertible into common stock at 110% of the principal amount plus accrued interest and make-whole amount, and is secured by a first-priority security interest in substantially all of the Company's assets, subject to permitted liens. This is a routine incremental warrant exercise and debt issuance under an existing securities purchase agreement, not a special situation. There are no deal terms to report.
